items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Also, Charlie Ventura, because Charlie was also on those records

ctx.x: Charlie loved Louis Armstrong, of course -- these are the little things that I know, and he also loved Little Jazz Roy Eldridge, he used to carry records of Roy when he was with Gene Krupa, around the room, and enjoyed them so much.

Also, Charlie Ventura, because Charlie was also on those records, and he used to play them for me. However, God will watch over Charlie Shavers in heaven, I know, and he'll be up there swapping beautiful lies with Ben Webster. I guess he always called Ben Webster 'frog' -- Ben was also called that in the Ellington band, too, with his bulging eyes, he gave that impression.
But by the same token, Ben called Charlie Shavers
